customManagers.description: Bump <NAME>_VERSION keys in komodo.env/testing.env. Per scripts/project-layout.md's convention, a container can pin a version via a _VERSION key instead of hardcoding the tag directly in compose.yaml's image: line — none currently do (every container hardcodes its tag today, handled by the docker-compose manager above instead), so this is forward-looking scaffolding. To use it: add a `# renovate: datasource=docker depName=<image>` comment directly above the `SOMETHING_VERSION: x.y.z` line.

packageRules.description: Major version bumps get their own dashboard-approval gate — everything else (minor/patch) opens a normal PR straight away. Komodo's ResourceSync is what actually redeploys once you merge; Renovate only opens the PR.
